claims: Maintain and monitor the phenylephrine infusion for hypotension, given recent mean arterial pressures around 60 mmHg.
Monitor arterial blood pressure closely with the arterial line and titrate vasopressor support to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure.
Continue the epidural infusion (hydromorphone and bupivacaine) and monitor for adequate analgesia and hemodynamic effects.
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status; adjust supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 above the desaturation limit.
Continue incentive spirometry and encourage deep breathing and coughing to prevent pulmonary complications.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy as indicated for glucose levels above target range.
Recheck complete blood count and electrolytes to monitor for anemia and electrolyte abnormalities.
Assess pain level and manage with multimodal analgesia, including acetaminophen and opioids as needed.
Implement fall precautions and assist with mobility given bed rest status and Braden activity score.
Monitor temperature and assess for signs of infection.
